# Advisor tool

Advisor calls run as a separate sub-inference billed at the advisor model's rates. Usage is reported in the `usage.iterations[]` array.

| Executor models                   | Advisor models                                                                                          |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Claude Fable 5 (claude-fable-5)   | Claude Mythos 5 (claude-mythos-5), Claude Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4-8)                                    |
| Claude Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4-8) | Claude Mythos 5 (claude-mythos-5), Claude Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4-8)                                    |
| Claude Opus 4.7 (claude-opus-4-7) | Claude Mythos 5 (claude-mythos-5), Claude Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4-8), Claude Opus 4.7 (claude-opus-4-7) |
| Claude Sonnet 5 (claude-sonnet-5) | Claude Mythos 5 (claude-mythos-5), Claude Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4-8)                                    |
